entities.title: The missile lock uses the active mount's axis
entities.summary: A missile locks on a ship in the active mount's sights.
entities.context: The baseline locks along the current view; LodeStar has one third-person view and four mounts.
entities.decision: try_lock tests the active mount's sights (RULES 6, deliberate difference 8).
entities.rationale: The lock follows the mount the pilot fires from.

entities.title: Firing and locking need the space view
entities.summary: Lasers fire, hit and lock only while the space view shows, not with a panel open.
entities.context: In the baseline the current view's laser fires; a panel over the view is not a view.
entities.decision: The flight tick passes whether the space view shows to the laser and the sights step (RULES 7, deliberate difference 9).
entities.rationale: Reading a chart in a fight stays a risk, as the original intended.
